description: Documentation MCP server for Cotal: search every docs page, list the table of contents, read any page as markdown. Read-only, no credentials. For actions on cotal.ai use the product server at https://cotal.ai/mcp.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Keyword search over every Cotal docs page; returns ranked pages with URLs and an excerpt.

tools.name: get_docs_page
tools.description: Reads one docs page as markdown by slug, path or URL.

tools.name: list_docs_pages
tools.description: Lists every docs page with title, section and URLs.
